title: WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations
description: The WHO SMART Guidelines immunizations implementation guide (FHIR IG source under input/), as a harnessed instance of smart-base: its L1 library (the DAK's Component 1 sources and L1 knowledge graph, and the measles L1-scenario example moved here from smart-base).

directories.description: L1 source content for this DAK: one `<bib-slug>/` per ingested WHO publication (`sections/*.md`, `structure.json`, `manifest.jsonld`, `blocks/`), the Component 1 L1 knowledge graph in `9789240099456-eng/smart-kg-l1-dak-references.json`, and `l1-recommendation-scenarios/measles/`, the worked example moved here from smart-base (owner, 2026-10-14, Q2 of the folio-assistant#2529 review: "Move it"). The id is `library`, the CONVENTIONAL one, so this entry overrides the default rather than joining it. Declared EXPLICITLY although the default already resolves `library/` in this checkout: remote-mount reads only declared directories, so without this entry an index mounting smart-immunizations mounts none of it, and gen-instance-contexts reads no document to build `ns/context/v1.jsonld` from.

The measles L1 recommendation-scenarios worked example (`measles/`: the 2017 position paper's L1 recommendations, the immunization vocabulary and mapping it resolves against, and the L2 scenario candidates `l1-recommendation-scenarios.ts` derives from them), moved here from smart-base by its 0c679ec (owner, Q2 of the folio-assistant#2529 reference-direction review: "Move it"). It is smart-base's `l1-extraction` kind, not a library entry: declared so a library reader does not grade it for sections and a manifest, and so its `$schema` families are not read as the library's.
